methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The scope of the project included mechanical and industrial control and automation alterations and optimizations required in order of converting the existing center break reduction cell to a point feeder reduction cell

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Process/automation retrofit case study (center-break to point-feed conversion of aluminium reduction cells). It reports specific energy consumption (kWh/t Al) and current efficiency as before/after operating outcomes of the retrofit, but does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model: no baseline energy model, normalisation methodology, functional form, variable selection, or estimation approach. EnPI appears incidentally (keyword plus reported KPI). Borderline against a minimal 'simple intensity ratio' reading.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this paper we will present an attempt which was made in order to retrofit a so-called center break cell to point feeder cell

stage1.notes: Primary aluminium (Hall-Heroult) smelter = closed-list Level-3B sector IF eligible. Called ineligible on strict v2.3 bar (SEC reported as retrofit outcome; no EnPI/EnB model characterised). Genuinely borderline; flag for blind-first human adjudication.
